description: ANSWERS: "how many FHA applications are withdrawn", "what share of FHA applications never reach a decision", "how many approved FHA loans are not taken", "why is the denied share 16.8% here and the denial rate 22.1% there", "where do <lender>'s FHA applications end". Returns the five HMDA ends of an application the lender acted on — originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness — as shares of applications acted on (actions 1-5), plus the approved-not-accepted share of approvals, nationally or for one of the 100 largest FHA lenders, each with its receipt. The denied share here is on a larger base than the published denial rate (22.1% of decisioned applications); both are returned so they can be reconciled. NOT FOR: why an application ended where it did (process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record), lender quality, or any individual outcome. Historical observation computed from the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2). Not a prediction about any individual application. Attribution: FinanceRateCalc, CC BY 4.0.
